about_the_game:
【Story Synopsis】

Once, there was a delinquent girl boss — Maren — who ruled her turf with an iron fist.
Through sheer strength and charisma, she brought countless delinquents under her command, standing proudly at the very peak of her domain.

One day, her beloved boyfriend — Ren — suddenly decided to move to another town.
“I just want to stay by Ren’s side.” With that single heartfelt wish, Maren resolved to follow him without hesitation.

However, the new town was also a world ruled by “bancho.”
Sitting at its top was a cunning, cold-hearted mastermind — one who wore a smile on the surface, but wielded ruthless schemes behind it.

Fists alone would no longer be enough —
A battle of strategy and domination was about to begin!

Can Maren conquer this unfamiliar land,
and protect her peaceful days together with Ren?

【Character Introduction】

Homura Maren

A powerful delinquent girl boss.
Once, with nothing but her own strength, she forced an entire region of delinquents to submit.

After meeting Ren Asagiri,

she came to realize that behind all that strength,

there was in fact a heart longing for gentle love.

Ren Asagiri

When Maren was expanding her influence,
I was once saved by her from the bullying of a delinquent gang.

I want Maren to break free from that dangerous world.
No matter what,
I want to become someone who will be useful to my future self.
And one day, I want to be someone who can protect Maren.

Sōga Kō

The bancho of a neighboring town.
Possesses immense strength, but an even sharper mind.
Holds exceptional skill.

However, in the end, he is nothing more than a vile and despicable man.

【Game System】

  • Certain maps use a simplified ARPG mode

  • Unique experiences from the male protagonist’s perspective

  • A JRPG focused on story immersion

  • Animated CG scenes

  • Exploration

*The demo’s content may be adjusted or changed in the final version.
